constraint reporting_s01.assets assets_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['snapshot'::text, 'artifact'::text, 'issue'::text])))
constraint reporting_s01.assets assets_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint reporting_s01.audit_events audit_events_action_check CHECK ((action = ANY (ARRAY['design.change'::text, 'design.release'::text, 'issue.submit'::text, 'export.submit'::text, 'artifact.download'::text, 'role.refused'::text, 'schedule.change'::text, 'schedule.run'::text, 'issue.cancel'::text])))
constraint reporting_s01.audit_events audit_events_code_check CHECK ((length(code) <= 64))
constraint reporting_s01.audit_events audit_events_id_check CHECK ((id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$'::text))
constraint reporting_s01.audit_events audit_events_object_id_check CHECK ((length(object_id) <= 64))
constraint reporting_s01.audit_events audit_events_object_kind_check CHECK ((object_kind = ANY (ARRAY['layout'::text, 'dashboard'::text, 'template'::text, 'background'::text, 'image'::text, 'issue'::text, 'export'::text, 'artifact'::text, 'route'::text, 'schedule'::text])))
constraint reporting_s01.audit_events audit_events_outcome_check CHECK ((outcome = ANY (ARRAY['requested'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'refused'::text, 'failed'::text])))
constraint reporting_s01.audit_events audit_events_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint reporting_s01.designs designs_data_check CHECK ((octet_length(data) <= 8388608))
constraint reporting_s01.designs designs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (store, tenant, issuer, subject)
constraint reporting_s01.designs designs_store_check CHECK ((store = ANY (ARRAY['layouts'::text, 'dashboards'::text, 'templates'::text, 'backgrounds'::text, 'images'::text])))
constraint reporting_s01.issue_cancellations issue_cancellations_issue_id_check CHECK ((issue_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$'::text))
constraint reporting_s01.issue_cancellations issue_cancellations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (issue_id)
constraint reporting_s01.issue_cancellations issue_cancellations_reason_check CHECK (((char_length(reason) >= 1) AND (char_length(reason) <= 200)))
constraint reporting_s01.issue_cancellations issue_cancellations_ref_check CHECK ((ref ~ '^[\x21-\x7E]{1,128}$'::text))
constraint reporting_s01.jobs jobs_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['snapshot'::text, 'export'::text, 'issue'::text])))
constraint reporting_s01.jobs jobs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint reporting_s01.jobs jobs_state_check CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'running'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'failed'::text, 'cancelled'::text])))
constraint reporting_s01.jobs jobs_tenant_integration_issuer_subject_kind_idem_key_key UNIQUE (tenant, integration, issuer, subject, kind, idem_key)
constraint reporting_s01.profile profile_pkey PRIMARY KEY (singleton)
constraint reporting_s01.profile profile_singleton_check CHECK (singleton)
constraint reporting_s01.schedule_runs schedule_runs_artifact_id_check CHECK (((artifact_id = ''::text) OR (artifact_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$'::text)))
constraint reporting_s01.schedule_runs schedule_runs_attempts_check CHECK (((attempts >= 0) AND (attempts <= 100)))
constraint reporting_s01.schedule_runs schedule_runs_data_sha256_check CHECK ((data_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
constraint reporting_s01.schedule_runs schedule_runs_delivery_check CHECK ((delivery = ANY (ARRAY['none'::text, 'pending'::text, 'delivered'::text, 'failed'::text])))
constraint reporting_s01.schedule_runs schedule_runs_error_code_check CHECK ((length(error_code) <= 64))
constraint reporting_s01.schedule_runs schedule_runs_export_job_check CHECK (((export_job = ''::text) OR (export_job ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$'::text)))
constraint reporting_s01.schedule_runs schedule_runs_id_check CHECK ((id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$'::text))
constraint reporting_s01.schedule_runs schedule_runs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint reporting_s01.schedule_runs schedule_runs_schedule_id_due_at_key UNIQUE (schedule_id, due_at)
constraint reporting_s01.schedule_runs schedule_runs_schedule_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (schedule_id) REFERENCES reporting_s01.schedules(id)
constraint reporting_s01.schedule_runs schedule_runs_snapshot_id_check CHECK (((snapshot_id = ''::text) OR (snapshot_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$'::text)))
constraint reporting_s01.schedule_runs schedule_runs_snapshot_job_check CHECK (((snapshot_job = ''::text) OR (snapshot_job ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$'::text)))
constraint reporting_s01.schedule_runs schedule_runs_state_check CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['due'::text, 'snapshot'::text, 'export'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'failed'::text, 'refused'::text, 'cancelled'::text])))
constraint reporting_s01.schedules schedules_check CHECK (((state = 'active'::text) = (next_run_at IS NOT NULL)))
constraint reporting_s01.schedules schedules_data_sha256_check CHECK ((data_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
constraint reporting_s01.schedules schedules_id_check CHECK ((id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$'::text))
constraint reporting_s01.schedules schedules_idem_key_check CHECK (((length(idem_key) >= 1) AND (length(idem_key) <= 128)))
constraint reporting_s01.schedules schedules_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint reporting_s01.schedules schedules_request_hash_check CHECK ((request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
constraint reporting_s01.schedules schedules_state_check CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'paused'::text, 'deleted'::text])))
constraint reporting_s01.schedules schedules_tenant_issuer_subject_idem_key_key UNIQUE (tenant, issuer, subject, idem_key)
constraint reporting_s01.schema_migrations schema_migrations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (version)
constraint reporting_s01.schema_migrations schema_migrations_version_check CHECK ((version > 0))
constraint reporting_s01.sweeps sweeps_artifacts_check CHECK ((artifacts >= 0))
constraint reporting_s01.sweeps sweeps_batch_check CHECK ((batch > 0))
constraint reporting_s01.sweeps sweeps_batches_check CHECK ((batches >= 0))
constraint reporting_s01.sweeps sweeps_grace_seconds_check CHECK ((grace_seconds >= 0))
constraint reporting_s01.sweeps sweeps_jobs_check CHECK ((jobs >= 0))
constraint reporting_s01.sweeps sweeps_objects_check CHECK ((objects >= 0))
constraint reporting_s01.sweeps sweeps_objects_left_check CHECK ((objects_left >= 0))
constraint reporting_s01.sweeps sweeps_orphans_check CHECK ((orphans >= 0))
constraint reporting_s01.sweeps sweeps_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint reporting_s01.sweeps sweeps_settled_from_check CHECK (((settled_from IS NULL) OR (reconciled AND complete AND (objects_left = 0) AND (NOT dry_run))))
constraint reporting_s01.sweeps sweeps_snapshots_check CHECK ((snapshots >= 0))
index assets assets_expires_at CREATE INDEX assets_expires_at ON reporting_s01.assets USING btree (expires_at)
index assets assets_identity_kind_expires CREATE INDEX assets_identity_kind_expires ON reporting_s01.assets USING btree (tenant, issuer, subject, kind, expires_at)
index assets assets_identity_results CREATE INDEX assets_identity_results ON reporting_s01.assets USING btree (tenant, issuer, subject, expires_at) WHERE ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['snapshot'::text, 'artifact'::text])) AND (NOT (data ? 'Issue'::text)))
index assets assets_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX assets_pkey ON reporting_s01.assets USING btree (id)
index audit_events audit_events_identity_at CREATE INDEX audit_events_identity_at ON reporting_s01.audit_events USING btree (tenant, issuer, subject, at DESC, id DESC)
index audit_events audit_events_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX audit_events_pkey ON reporting_s01.audit_events USING btree (id)
index audit_events audit_events_tenant_at CREATE INDEX audit_events_tenant_at ON reporting_s01.audit_events USING btree (tenant, issuer, at DESC, id DESC)
index designs designs_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX designs_pkey ON reporting_s01.designs USING btree (store, tenant, issuer, subject)
index issue_cancellations issue_cancellations_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX issue_cancellations_pkey ON reporting_s01.issue_cancellations USING btree (issue_id)
index jobs jobs_claim CREATE INDEX jobs_claim ON reporting_s01.jobs USING btree (state, created_at)
index jobs jobs_identity_created CREATE INDEX jobs_identity_created ON reporting_s01.jobs USING btree (tenant, issuer, subject, created_at DESC)
index jobs jobs_identity_in_flight CREATE INDEX jobs_identity_in_flight ON reporting_s01.jobs USING btree (tenant, issuer, subject) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'running'::text]))
index jobs jobs_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jobs_pkey ON reporting_s01.jobs USING btree (id)
index jobs jobs_reducible CREATE INDEX jobs_reducible ON reporting_s01.jobs USING btree (source_expires_at) WHERE ((state = ANY (ARRAY['succeeded'::text, 'failed'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND (NOT (data ? 'Reduced'::text)))
index jobs jobs_tenant_integration_issuer_subject_kind_idem_key_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jobs_tenant_integration_issuer_subject_kind_idem_key_key ON reporting_s01.jobs USING btree (tenant, integration, issuer, subject, kind, idem_key)
index profile profile_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX profile_pkey ON reporting_s01.profile USING btree (singleton)
index schedule_runs schedule_runs_open CREATE INDEX schedule_runs_open ON reporting_s01.schedule_runs USING btree (check_at) WHERE ((state = ANY (ARRAY['due'::text, 'snapshot'::text, 'export'::text])) OR (delivery = 'pending'::text))
index schedule_runs schedule_runs_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX schedule_runs_pkey ON reporting_s01.schedule_runs USING btree (id)
index schedule_runs schedule_runs_schedule_id_due_at_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX schedule_runs_schedule_id_due_at_key ON reporting_s01.schedule_runs USING btree (schedule_id, due_at)
index schedules schedules_due CREATE INDEX schedules_due ON reporting_s01.schedules USING btree (next_run_at) WHERE (state = 'active'::text)
index schedules schedules_identity_created CREATE INDEX schedules_identity_created ON reporting_s01.schedules USING btree (tenant, issuer, subject, created_at DESC, id DESC)
index schedules schedules_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX schedules_pkey ON reporting_s01.schedules USING btree (id)
index schedules schedules_tenant_issuer_subject_idem_key_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX schedules_tenant_issuer_subject_idem_key_key ON reporting_s01.schedules USING btree (tenant, issuer, subject, idem_key)
index schema_migrations schema_migrations_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX schema_migrations_pkey ON reporting_s01.schema_migrations USING btree (version)
index sweeps sweeps_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sweeps_pkey ON reporting_s01.sweeps USING btree (id)
index sweeps sweeps_reconciliation CREATE INDEX sweeps_reconciliation ON reporting_s01.sweeps USING btree (COALESCE(settled_from, at), id) WHERE ((NOT dry_run) AND ((settled_from IS NOT NULL) OR (objects_left > 0) OR (NOT complete)))
